title: Peach Caprese with Mozzarella, Lemon and Basil
changes_from_base: Ripe peach slices replace the tomatoes and a squeeze of lemon sharpens the oil.
summary: A late-summer twist on caprese: juicy peach slices layered with creamy mozzarella, dressed with lemon and olive oil and finished with torn basil.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
ripe peaches (about 500 g), stoned and sliced

steps.title: Dress the peaches
steps.text: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper in the bowl, add the peach slices and turn them gently to coat.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Overlap the peaches and mozzarella on the platter.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Pour over any dressing left in the bowl, scatter with basil and add a little more pepper. Serve at room temperature.

tips: Use ripe but firm peaches so the slices hold their shape.
Nectarines work just as well; no need to peel either.
Serve at room temperature for the best flavour.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
